body:
I am taking Seroquel for bipolar/psychosis. The nitrous has an extremely power affect on Seroquel. Intensity of the combination is the equivalant of taking 4 hits of LSD and peaking. Please use caution if you are not extremely experienced with psychedelic drugs. This is a very intense and powerful combination. Seroquel seems to intensify psychedelic drugs; at least Nitrous Oxide thus far.
This was meant to help the scientific community and patients taking Seroquel to understand more about interactions with other drugs.
When I combine these two substances I enter a extremely strong psychedelic mindstate with visuals / auditory effects. Almost so unexpected it is like taking a hit of Salvia Divinorum but the effects of this combination is far more on this planet still. Very intense effects please use with caution!!
